context:
Goal: a PR whose quotes of you match your feedback word for word skips the ruling-record review round.
Problem (rule): your feedback log is a file per session outside git, so the merge tool and CI cannot read it, and part 2 needs you to pick who checks the match.
Based on (read): decision owner-feedback-inbox (one feedback file per session, outside git) and plan R18 point 5 (the sending session checks a relayed grant against its own log).
Departs from: main — adds a quote check the merge tool has no reader for today.
home: step express-pass-owner-quotes (a PR quoting you word for word skips a review round)

options.gain: A real match against the log, with no new form the merge tool trusts.
options.how: Part 2 waits for step feedback-log-tends-itself (a tracked, repo-wide feedback log), then the merge tool reads it; until then the express pass skips nothing.
options.label: Wait for the shared log (Recommended)
options.lose: The express pass skips nothing until then.

options.how: The sending session checks the quotes against its own feedback file and writes a stamp line the merge tool trusts. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.
options.label: Session stamps the match
options.lose: The merge tool trusts a session's word, not a read of the log.

reply: Closed 14:14 CST: part 2 uses the session stamp for now; lane express-pass-owner-quotes told.
short: Quote match: wait for shared log
title: Wait for the shared feedback log before a quote match skips a review round
why: The merge tool cannot read the feedback log the plan names.
